_meta.description: phantomdeps B0/B1/B2/B3 evaluation corpus — labelled deterministic cases
_meta.author: Narayan Kumar Jha (Contributor 2)

labels.B0: Package-name existence and basic registry check only
labels.B1: B0 plus exact package/version/integrity and risk signals
labels.B2: B1 plus static imported-symbol/API claim verification
labels.B3: B2 delivered through the wrapper or tested Bob hook, including repair and test rerun

cases.description: Real package, AI-generated symbol does NOT exist — deterministic BLOCK
cases.label: wrong_symbol
cases.notes: isOddBatch is absent from is-odd@3.0.1; the only export is isOdd(). Version-pinned. Static inspection only — no code execution.

cases.description: Real package, AI-generated symbol EXISTS — ALLOW
cases.label: valid_import
cases.notes: merge is a documented top-level export of lodash@4.17.21. Should produce ALLOW with no block finding.

cases.description: Package has install lifecycle scripts — WARN
cases.label: install_script_risk
cases.notes: Symbol is present but install scripts trigger a WARN. No block because symbol check passes.

cases.label: package_not_found
cases.notes: Policy engine with null evidence produces l1.not_found BLOCK. Tests B0 base layer.

cases.label: registry_unavailable
cases.notes: Policy engine with UNAVAILABLE evidence produces UNVERIFIED. Must never convert to ALLOW.

cases.description: Shell metacharacter injection attempt — rejected by parser
cases.label: shell_injection
cases.notes: parseIntent() must throw on shell metacharacters. Verified in tests/parser.test.ts.

cases.label: protocol_injection
cases.notes: PROTOCOL_RE must reject URL forms. Only registry-name specs are supported in v1.

cases.description: Missing claim context on live path — UNVERIFIED (not silent ALLOW)
cases.label: missing_claim_context
cases.notes: Phase 13.1: claimContextKind=missing must produce l2.context_missing + UNVERIFIED. Never silent ALLOW.

cases.description: Diff context: newly added import of absent symbol — BLOCK
cases.label: diff_wrong_symbol
cases.notes: Phase 13.2: extractAddedImports parses +lines only. isOddBatch absent from fixture.

cases.description: Diff context: import of existing symbol — ALLOW
cases.label: diff_valid_symbol
cases.notes: Phase 13.2: merge confirmed in lodash@4.17.21 fixture. Should produce ALLOW.

cases.description: Young package (< 30 days) — WARN risk signal
cases.label: young_package
cases.notes: risky-new-pkg fixture has a recent publishedAt and hasInstallScript=true. Both trigger WARN.

cases.description: Artifact integrity unavailable (no hash) — WARN, not BLOCK
cases.label: artifact_integrity_unavailable
cases.notes: Phase 12.2: missing integrity hash → WARN via noArtifactIntegrity. Must NOT say 'no provenance'.
